title: Client-Side Caching Advanced
description: Deep dive into Apollo Client caching mechanisms, cache configuration, and advanced cache manipulation.
longDescription: This module covers advanced Apollo Client caching topics including cache configuration, custom cache resolvers, type policies, field policies, cache redirects, and how to fine-tune the normalized cache for complex applications.
whatYouLearn: Configure Apollo Client cache settings for optimal performance
Use type policies and field policies to control cache behavior
Implement custom cache resolvers for complex data relationships
Set up cache redirects to prevent unnecessary queries
